source: xochi docs/planning/shielded-execution.md §7 (Readiness evidence; "Decided 2026-10-19: readiness attestation"), xochi-fi/pxe-bridge#50, xochi-fi/xochi-sdk#42
scope: Membership and RootUpdate are design-A testnet-tracer readiness (B-panel has no spending-limit allowlist); RecipientDeployment serves both designs.

domain.name: Xochi Shielded Readiness
domain.chainId: the corridor's source chain id (a manifest identity field); never the source wallet's chain as such, which the bridge never learns
domain.manifestDigest: folded into the salt as the third abi-encoded word, not a domain member: EIP-712 defines only name, version, chainId, verifyingContract and salt as domain members, so a manifestDigest member would make the domain non-standard

types.typeString: Membership(bytes32 descriptorDigest,bytes32 root,bool member,uint64 rootBlock,uint64 attestedAt)
RecipientDeployment(bytes32 descriptorDigest,bytes32 recipient,bytes32 classId,bool deployed,uint64 finalBlock,uint64 attestedAt)

wire: rootBlock / finalBlock: canonical decimal strings (uint64), so heights never pass through an unsafe JS number
signature: 0x + 65 bytes (r || s || v), EIP-712 over secp256k1 by the bridge's dedicated attestation key
no leaf index, path or witness is ever part of a record
a verifier rebuilds the domain from its own corridor record (environment, network, source chain, manifestDigest) and checks the recovered address against the attestation key it pins
